_readme: This is the ONE file to edit for site content. Any text value that starts with "TODO" is treated as missing: the site hides it automatically. Replace the TODO text with the real value and it appears on the next deploy. Run `node build.mjs` to check; it lists every remaining TODO. See README.md > Editing content.

about.intro: Born from the river. Raised by the canyon. We live for water, wilderness, and bringing people together outside.

sections.title: Our Roots
sections.text: Founded in 1998 by locals and lifelong river runners, Taos River Adventures started as a two-boat operation and has grown into one of New Mexico’s top outdoor outfitters.

sections.title: Our Mission
sections.text: We’re here to share the magic of the Rio Grande. Our trips are guided by a deep respect for nature, Indigenous lands, and the joy of safe, authentic adventure.

sections.title: Meet the Team
sections.text: Our guides are certified, passionate, and fun — and many have been with us for over a decade. Whether you’re paddling hard or floating easy, they’ve got your back.

safety.whatToBringNote: A general checklist for a day on the river. Ask us if you’re unsure about anything for your trip.
whatToBring: Sunscreen, sunglasses with a strap, and a hat
Shoes that strap securely to your feet — no flip-flops
A dry change of clothes and a towel for after the trip
guestTips: Tell us about any medical conditions, allergies or swimming concerns when you book.
Listen to your guide — they know the river.
Ask questions! There’s no such thing as a silly question on the river.

faq.a: No. Our Half-Day Whitewater trip through the Lower Gorge is perfect for first-timers and families.
Yes — kids are welcome! We run rafting experiences for families and groups. Get in touch and we’ll help you choose the right trip for your family.

faq.q: Which trip has the biggest rapids?
faq.a: The Full-Day Racecourse, with Class III rapids on the iconic Racecourse stretch.
The Full-Day Racecourse includes a riverside lunch.

faq.q: Is there a trip without much paddling?
faq.a: Yes — the Scenic Float drifts down the mellow stretches of the river with minimal paddling required.

faq.q: Can we have a boat to ourselves?
faq.a: Yes. Book a private guide and boat for a fully tailored adventure — half or full day options are available.
The Half-Day Whitewater trip has daily departures. Contact us for availability on other trips.
Send us a booking request with the form on our Book & Contact page, or email us directly. We’re available 8am – 6pm daily.
